title: Yehiam CHELSA precipitation investigation

checks.scaleFactorApplied: raw_integer / 10 → mm (CHELSA V2.1 precip COG convention)
checks.nodataHandling: GDAL nodata rejected when present (65535 for precip-class uint16)
checks.orientation: lon→x, lat→y with north-up bbox (ymax - lat)

qaIndependentReference.note: QA only — does not replace CHELSA. Western Galilee / northern Israel station & WorldClim-class normals commonly cited ~500–900 mm/yr depending on site.
qaIndependentReference.implication: CHELSA cell value is wetter than many observed local normals → model-vs-observed uncertainty retained; CHELSA remains authority.

aridityFollowUp: UNEP AI = P/PET from CHELSA pet_penman with raw/100 scale (CMI-validated); precip-band moisture label retired when PET present

chelsaOfficialAiLayerQa.note: CHELSA bio AI float at same cell ≈ 1.357 (humid). Derived UNEP P/sum(monthly pet_penman) may differ slightly from the published annual AI layer; both remain CHELSA-family.
